title: Place of trial, etc.–(1) Any person subject to this Act who commits any offence under this Act
text:
91. Place of trial, etc.–(1) Any person subject to this Act who commits any offence under this Act
may be tried and punished for such offence at any place.

(2) The persons by whom an accused may be defended in a trial and appearance of such persons
thereat may be as prescribed.
